title: CD200 and CD200R Levels in Psoriasis Patients
author: Carmen Farid
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6zihf4e

steps.title: Collect and split blood sample
steps.instruction: Withdraw 5 ml of fresh venous blood from each participant under aseptic conditions into an EDTA tube; immediately split the sample into two 2.5 ml aliquots.

steps.title: Separate serum and store
steps.instruction: Centrifuge one 2.5 ml aliquot (speed and time as per standard serum separation) to obtain serum, then aliquot the serum and store at –80 °C until all samples can be assayed in a single ELISA run.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA plate for CD200
steps.instruction: Use the Human CD200 PicoKine™ ELISA Kit (Boster Biological Technology, Catalog # EK0993) which contains 96‑well plates pre‑coated with anti‑CD200 capture antibody.

steps.title: Add standards and samples
steps.instruction: Add the provided standards and each serum test sample (volume as specified by the kit, typically 100 µl) to the appropriate wells of the pre‑coated plate.

steps.title: Add detection antibody and wash
steps.instruction: Add the biotinylated anti‑CD200 detection antibody to each well, incubate as directed, then wash the wells three times with PBS buffer.

steps.title: Add Avidin‑Biotin‑HRP complex
steps.instruction: Add the Avidin‑Biotin‑Peroxidase Complex to each well, incubate per kit instructions, and wash again with PBS buffer.

steps.title: Develop color with TMB
steps.instruction: Add HRP substrate TMB to each well, allow color development (blue) for the time specified by the kit, then add the acidic stop solution to convert the color to yellow.

steps.title: Read ELISA plate
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the yellow product at the wavelength indicated by the kit (typically 450 nm); calculate CD200 concentrations using the standard curve.

steps.title: Stain fresh blood for CD200R
steps.instruction: Take the second 2.5 ml fresh blood aliquot; add 100 µl of EDTA whole blood to a tube containing mouse anti‑human CD200R1 Fluorescein‑conjugated monoclonal antibody (Human CD200 R1 Fluorescein‑conjugated Antibody, Bio‑Techne, Catalog # FAB3414F).

steps.title: Incubate and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the stained blood for the time recommended by the antibody supplier (typically 15–30 min at room temperature), then add 2.0 ml of lysing solution, allow lysis for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Wash the lysed cells twice with PBS buffer by centrifugation, discard supernatant each time, and finally resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate volume of PBS for flow cytometry.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Analyze the resuspended cells on a FACSCalibur flow cytometer using CellQuest Pro software (BD Biosciences); record the mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) of CD200R on peripheral blood monocytes.
